newsitem.title: USA: U.S. exporters report soybeans sold to Taiwan - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. exporters report soybeans sold to Taiwan - USDA.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Wednesday private exporters reported sales of 108,000 tonnes of soybeans to Taiwan for delivery during the 1996-97 marketing year.
The marketing year for soybeans began Sept 1.
USDA issues daily and weekly export sales reports.
Exporters must report to USDA sales of 100,000 tonnes or more of one commodity made in one day to a single destination by 1500 ET the next business day after the sale.
Sales of lesser quantities must be reported weekly.
